policy: Complete Lean stdout, source helper/runner/driver and headline type text are byte-exact/unredacted. Only path identities in structured config/receipt/inventories/closure and compiler prefix banner are projected. Original hashes retained.
path_separators: Structured Windows path identities become forward-slash role paths; logical module names, source spellings, hashes and all Lean statements are untouched.

compiler_prefix_banner.replacement: Exact reported toolchain prefix replaced by <toolchain> plus newline.
